notes: Enterprise MDM, endpoint security, and identity agent USER-visible caches/logs under $HOME (and a few user-writable diagnose dumps). Prefer logs/caches as aged low-risk clean; enrollment profiles, Managed Preferences, profile payloads, agent config/state are report-only. System roots (/Library/Application Support/JAMF, /Library/Addigy, /Library/CS, /Library/Managed Preferences, /var/db/ConfigurationProfiles, sensor binaries) stay out of paths or report-only notes only: merge never-touch drops bare /Library. Do not touch Documents/Desktop/Downloads, Keychains, or live enrollment tokens required for managed state.
